import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by product and date
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create a line plot for daily sales for each product
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Daily Sales by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Product', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='10')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
